intro.en: The harbor ledger, a record of debts owed to shadowy smugglers, vanished in a blaze that lit the lighthouse stove at midnight. Three locals were the last to see the ledger—or its flames.
intro.pt: O livro do porto, registro das dívidas com contrabandistas, desapareceu em um incêndio que iluminou a lareira do farol à meia‑noite. Três moradores foram os últimos a ver o livro — ou suas chamas.

solution.en: The harbor bookkeeper, Marta Reis, set the ledger ablaze to hide the debts. She used the lighthouse stove, counted on the night shift to keep her alibi, and tried to blame the darkness and a stray lantern.
solution.pt: A contadora do porto, Marta Reis, incendiou o livro para esconder as dívidas. Ela usou a lareira do farol, contou com o turno noturno para criar um álibi e tentou culpar a escuridão e uma lanterna perdida.

suspects.facts: Marta knows she burned the ledger to erase the smuggler debts. She fabricated a story that she stayed home all night, hoping no one will verify her claim. She is aware that Lia saw her soot‑covered boots and that Tomás noticed a lantern near the stove, but she will deflect suspicion onto the unknown lantern holder.

Tomás saw a lantern flicker near the stove room at 23:00, but the face was hidden. He spent the night in the lamp room, monitoring the light, and can confirm his own alibi. He knows Lia's boots were dirty, but he will stick to the factual observation of the lantern.

Lia noticed Marta's boots blackened with soot the next morning, a clear sign of recent fire work. She was at the tavern until midnight, then returned home, giving her a solid alibi. She will repeat what she saw but will not admit any involvement.

clues.ask: Did you see anyone near the stove at 23:00?

text.en: Tomás saw a lantern near the stove room at 23:00, but couldn't see a face.
text.pt: Tomás viu uma lanterna perto da sala da lareira às 23:00, mas não conseguiu ver o rosto.

clues.ask: Did you notice any boots covered in soot this morning?

text.en: Lia noticed Marta's boots were black with soot when she arrived at the harbor.
text.pt: Lia notou que as botas de Marta estavam negras de fuligem ao chegar ao porto.

text.en: Marta claims she was home all night, though no one can confirm.
text.pt: Marta afirma que ficou em casa a noite toda, embora ninguém possa confirmar.

clues.ask: What time did you leave the tavern last night?

text.en: Lia says she was at the tavern until midnight before heading home.
text.pt: Lia diz que esteve na taberna até a meia‑noite antes de voltar para casa.

clues.ask: Did you stay in the lamp room all night?

text.en: Tomás states he remained in the lamp room throughout the night, watching the light.
text.pt: Tomás afirma que permaneceu na sala da lâmpada a noite inteira, cuidando da luz.

clues.ask: Did you find any remnants of the ledger?

text.en: A charred fragment of the harbor ledger was found near the stove, still bearing Marta's initials.
text.pt: Um fragmento carbonizado do livro do porto foi encontrado perto da lareira, ainda com as iniciais de Marta.
